findings.evidence: Lines 58–63 define the submodule using `(galoisGroupEquivCandidateGenusField hd).mapSubgroup ...fixingSubgroup`; lines 66–73 prove only the resulting existential restatement, while no theorem computes the action of a sign vector on `candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot`.
findings.fix: Relate `candidateGenusFieldBaseRoot` to the product of the prime-discriminant generators and prove an explicit coordinate criterion (typically the parity-zero/kernel-of-sum condition), then identify the fixing subgroup with that independently defined submodule.
findings.issue: `candidateGenusFieldRelativeSignSubmodule` is defined as the image of the fixing subgroup, and the membership theorem at line 66 merely unfolds that definition; thus the relative equivalence is generic subgroup transport rather than an identification of which sign patterns fix the quadratic base.

summary: The claimed sign-subspace identification is circular: the subspace is defined as the transported fixing subgroup, so the difficult mathematical characterization is absent.
